statements.text: .@ENERGY announced $16M for 15 projects across the country for research on artificial intelligence and machine learning for Nuclear Physics, and three of these projects are based right here in NM! 🔬 Proud to see NM continue being a leader in scientific research.

I've heard it loud and clear from folks in Socorro County: they don't want one of the world's largest data centers in their backyard. The current proposal offers limited transparency and a lack of clear answers, and it should not be considered at this time. This massive data center would likely degrade quality of life for many residents who have strongly voiced their opposition.
statements.venue: Statement on Socorro County data center, via Source NM

statements.text: New Mexico's water, air and resources belong to us, not to billionaires from coastal states who see an opportunity to extract profit from our land. I've been appalled at the backroom deals, silencing of dissenting voices, shady NDAs and shell companies, and the overall lack of transparency from those who seek to do business in our state.
statements.venue: Statement on co-sponsoring data center bills, via Source NM

statements.text: Congress must answer the urgent call for immediate action on AI regulation, and leaving Washington without addressing this matter would be reckless and irresponsible. It's clear there is great risk in the continued development of super intelligence with no guardrails, and Speaker Johnson and the President refuse to act responsibly and decisively. I have recently championed the bipartisan FRONTIER Act, one of several bills I've supported that merit debate and a vote on the House floor.
statements.venue: Press release on FRONTIER Act and letter to Speaker Johnson

statements.text: Questionable data center developers are striking murky deals in rural communities across the country, locking in sweetheart deals without public input or transparency. They purposefully withhold information about their water use, emissions, and electricity costs — all while they actively get tax breaks passed by MAGA extremists' in the Big Ugly Bill that were offset by cuts to healthcare and food assistance for hardworking Americans. I'm proud to lead this bill to end these tax breaks.
statements.venue: Press release on data center tax breaks bill and Grant County moratorium

statements.text: Congress must answer the urgent call for immediate action on AI regulation. It's clear there is great risk in the continued development of super intelligence with no federal or state guardrails, and I have championed the bipartisan FRONTIER Act to establish essential safety standards for the most advanced AI systems.
We can't spare a drop of water for billionaires who are not going to invest in our community.
statements.venue: Debate with Greg Cunningham, reported by Source NM
